item.title: Law would protect churches from protests
item.description: Legislation that would expand Louisiana’s “disturbing the peace” statute to cover disruptions of church services has been filed ahead of the 2026 session that begins in March.

item.title: Officials pledge to put focus on road, bridge maintenance
item.description: LSU Manship School News Service/Cross Harris State Rep. Ryan Bourriaque is pushing to fix the state’s road and bridges. BATON ROUGE—State officials say they will prioritize maintenance projects, especially on rural roads and bridges, as they seek to reduce an estimated $19 billion backlog in highway projects.
